_meta.description: Seed (placeholder) seismic hazard ZONE and GROUND-MOTION parameters for MKM-SEIS-001. ALL VALUES ARE ENGINEERING-JUDGEMENT SEEDS, not calibrated. Zone annual rates and Gutenberg-Richter coefficients are Appendix A; GMPE selection, V_S30 site-class proxies and total sigma are Appendix C of docs/seismic/MKM-SEIS-001-v0.10.md. Numbers are physically defensible starting points to be recalibrated under SEIS-R1/SEIS-R2.

zones._doc: Appendix A1 — seismic hazard zone annual rates (M >= m_min mainshock). lambda_zone is the mean annual rate of events at or above m_min; b is the Gutenberg-Richter b-value; m_min/m_max bound the truncated G-R magnitude draw. tectonic_regime selects the GMPE.

hazard_class_to_zone._doc: Maps the CDM HazardProfile.SeismicHazardClass menu (None/Low/Medium/High/Extreme) to the model's zone labels above. The CDM class is the read-time selector; the zone carries the rate/magnitude parameters.

ground_motion._doc: Model B — Ground Motion Prediction Equation (GMPE). Seed uses a single parametric Boore-Atkinson-style form per tectonic regime: ln(PGA_g) = c0 + c1*(M - mref) + c2*(M - mref)^2 + (c3 + c5*(M - mref))*ln(sqrt(R_JB^2 + h^2)) + c4*ln(Vs30 / vref). PGA is in g. The geometric-spreading term is MAGNITUDE-DEPENDENT (c5 >= 0): large ruptures decay more slowly and remain damaging at far greater distances than small ones, so an M8+ event is felt/damaging out to ~500-1000 km while an M6.5 attenuates within ~100 km. Seeds reproduce the M6.5 near-field of Section 7.2 (Table 1) and a realistic large-event reach. Replace under SEIS-R2 with a vetted published GMPE.

subduction_interface.label: Zhao et al. 2006 — seed parametric proxy (Halong / Red River system)

site_class._doc: Appendix C2 — Eurocode 8 site-class V_S30 proxies and the GS02 soil-amplification gate. When CDM SoilVs30Mps is present it is used directly; otherwise the proxy for the derived class applies. site_class is derived from V_S30 by the bands below (m/s).

vs30_bands._doc: Lower V_S30 bound (m/s) for each Eurocode 8 class; a V_S30 at or above the bound and below the next-higher class' bound takes that class. A >= 760, B >= 360, C >= 180, D >= 120, E < 120.

soil_recurrence_m_soil._doc: Appendix A3 — soil recurrence modifier m_soil applied to the asset occurrence rate.

soil_amplification._doc: Appendix C2 — when GS02 (seismic foundation design) is ABSENT and the site class is in applies_classes, the GMPE median is multiplied by fa before sampling.
